premise: Frog and Snail wish for rain and Butterfly wishes for sun; the rain comes and Butterfly has to hide, so Frog and Snail wish for sun for her — and the sky gives them both, and a rainbow for everyone.
inspiration: The Father and His Two Daughters (Aesop), where one wants rain and the other sun; turned: the friends start wishing for each other, and nobody has to lose.
lesson: A wish for a friend is the best wish.

en-US.title: Frog and the Two Wishes
en-US.text: [curious] What's the best weather? {frog:enter} Frog knew. {frog:hop x2} Rain! Splishy, splashy rain! Slowly, {snail:enter} Snail crawled up and nodded. Too dry out here, he said, {snail:live} and hid in his shell. {snail:face happy} Rain is lovely! But {butterfly:enter} Butterfly shook her head. {butterfly:spin} Sun! Warm, golden sun! So Frog wished for rain. Snail wished for rain. And Butterfly wished for sun. {canvas:rain 0.7 22s} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter, pitter-patter… down came the rain! {frog:face happy} {frog:hop x3} Frog bounced for joy. {snail:pulse} Snail stretched out his eyes. But Butterfly's wings were getting wet. She flew to the red {mushroom:enter} mushroom, {butterfly:go under mushroom} tucked in under the cap, {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live hold} and folded her wings. [sad] Oh dear. Frog looked at Butterfly. {snail:face sad} Snail looked at Butterfly. Then they made a new wish. [whispers] Sun, please. For our friend. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} And out came the sun. {butterfly:live resume} Butterfly opened her wings… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} and up she fluttered. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] Look! Rain and sun together made a rainbow. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] Everybody's wish, all at once.

es-ES.title: Rana y los dos deseos
es-ES.text: [curious] ¿Cuál es el mejor tiempo? {frog:enter} Rana lo tenía claro. {frog:hop x2} ¡Lluvia que salpica! Despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol y asintió. Qué seco, dijo, {snail:live} y se metió en su concha. {snail:face happy} ¡La lluvia es fresquita! Pero {butterfly:enter} Mariposa negó con la cabeza. {butterfly:spin} ¡Sol! ¡Sol calentito! Así que Rana pidió lluvia. Caracol pidió lluvia. Y Mariposa pidió sol. {canvas:rain 0.7 22s} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc… ¡se puso a llover! {frog:face happy} {frog:hop x3} Rana saltaba de alegría. {snail:pulse} Caracol estiró los cuernos. Pero a Mariposa se le mojaban las alas. Voló hasta la {mushroom:enter} seta roja, {butterfly:go under mushroom} se metió debajo {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live hold} y plegó las alas. [sad] Vaya. Rana miró a Mariposa. {snail:face sad} Caracol miró a Mariposa. Y pidieron otro deseo. [whispers] Sol, por favor. Para nuestra amiga. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} Y salió el sol. {butterfly:live resume} Mariposa abrió las alas… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} y echó a volar. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] ¡Mirad! La lluvia y el sol juntos hicieron un arcoíris. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] El deseo de todos, a la vez.
